```json
        "contents": "export const MindMapProvider =\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  // Viewport adjustment\n  const adjustViewport = useCallback(\n    ({x, y, zoom = 0, duration = 800}: FlowPosition) =\u003e {\n      reactFlowInstance.setViewport({x, y, zoom}, {duration})\n    },\n    [reactFlowInstance]\n  )\n\n  // Child node batch index management\n  const updateChildNodeBatchIndex = useCallback(\n    (type: RootNodeKey, amount?: number, cursor?: string) =\u003e {\n      setRootNodeState((state: Record\u003cRootNodeKey, {lastIndex: number; cursor?: string}\u003e) =\u003e ({\n        ...state,\n        [type]: {\n          ...state[type],\n          lastIndex: state[type].lastIndex + (amount || childNodeBatchSize),\n          ...(cursor \u0026\u0026 {cursor}),\n        },\n      }))\n    },\n    [childNodeBatchSize]\n  )\n\n  // Node detection functions\n  const detectNodeOverlap = useCallback(\n    (node: {id: string}): Node[] =\u003e {\n      const source = reactFlowInstance.getNode(node.id)\n      if (!source) return []\n\n      return reactFlowInstance.getIntersectingNodes(source)\n    },\n    [reactFlowInstance]\n  )\n\n  // Group and node management\n  const addMindMapGroupNode = useCallback(\n    ({\n      connectionNode,\n      model,\n      nodeType = 'entityGroupNode',\n      groupId,\n      position,\n    }: {\n      model: string\n      childNodes?: any[]\n      nodeType: string\n      position: XYPosition\n      groupId: string\n      connectionNode: Node\n    }) =\u003e {\n      const edgeId = &#96;${groupId}&#96;\n      const newNode: any = {\n        ...entityGroupNodeBaseConfig,\n        id: groupId,\n        type: nodeType,\n        data: {model},\n        position,\n      }\n\n      const newEdge = {\n        id: edgeId,\n        source: connectionNode.id,\n        target: newNode.id,\n        type: 'smoothstep',\n      }\n\n      store.addNodes(newNode)\n      store.addEdges([newEdge])\n    },\n    [store.addNodes, store.addEdges]\n  )",

        "originalContents": "\n\n  // Viewport adjustment\n  const adjustViewport = useCallback(\n    ({x, y, zoom = 0, duration = 800}: FlowPosition) =\u003e {\n      reactFlowInstance.setViewport({x, y, zoom}, {duration})\n    },\n    [reactFlowInstance]\n  )\n\n  // Child node batch index management\n  const updateChildNodeBatchIndex = useCallback(\n    (type: RootNodeKey, amount?: number, cursor?: string) =\u003e {\n      setRootNodeState((state: Record\u003cRootNodeKey, {lastIndex: number; cursor?: string}\u003e) =\u003e ({\n        ...state,\n        [type]: {\n          ...state[type],\n          lastIndex: state[type].lastIndex + (amount || childNodeBatchSize),\n          ...(cursor \u0026\u0026 {cursor}),\n        },\n      }))\n    },\n    [childNodeBatchSize]\n  )\n\n  // Node detection functions\n  const detectNodeOverlap = useCallback(\n    (node: {id: string}): Node[] =\u003e {\n      const source = reactFlowInstance.getNode(node.id)\n      if (!source) return []\n\n      return reactFlowInstance.getIntersectingNodes(source)\n    },\n    [reactFlowInstance]\n  )\n\n  // Group and node management\n  const addMindMapGroupNode = useCallback(\n    ({\n      connectionNode,\n      model,\n      nodeType = 'entityGroupNode',\n      groupId,\n      position,\n    }: {\n      model: string\n      childNodes?: any[]\n      nodeType: string\n      position: XYPosition\n      groupId: string\n      connectionNode: Node\n    }) =\u003e {\n      const edgeId = &#96;${groupId}&#96;\n      const newNode: any = {\n        ...entityGroupNodeBaseConfig,\n        id: groupId,\n        type: nodeType,\n        data: {model},\n        position,\n      }\n\n      const newEdge = {\n        id: edgeId,\n        source: connectionNode.id,\n        target: newNode.id,\n        type: 'smoothstep',\n      }\n\n      store.addNodes(newNode)\n      store.addEdges([newEdge])\n    },\n    [store.addNodes, store.addEdges]\n  )",
```

```json
        "originalContents": "'use client'\n\nimport { useState, useEffect } from 'react'\nimport { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion'\nimport { Brain, Users, Building2, Clock, MapPin, ChevronRight, Loader, Sparkles, RefreshCw } from 'lucide-react'\nimport { useMindMap } from '@/contexts/mindmap/mindmap-context'\nimport { getGraphContext, isRecordRelated, generateContextualSearchRules } from '@/features/mindmap/utils/contextual-intelligence'\nimport { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'\n\ninterface ConnectedRecord {\n  id: string\n  type: 'personnel' | 'organizations' | 'events' | 'documents' | 'testimonies'\n  title: string\n  snippet: string\n  relationshipScore: number\n  relationshipType: 'personnel' | 'temporal' | 'organizational' | 'topic' | 'location'\n  confidence: number\n}",

        "contents": "export function ConnectedRecordsPanel() {\n  ...\n  const fetchContextualConnections = async\n\n      \n      ...\n\n      \n      for (const record of recordsToProcess.slice(0, 8)) {\n        if (isRecordRelated(record, graphContext)) {\n          const relationshipScore = calculateRelationshipScore(record, graphContext)\n          const relationshipType = determineRelationshipType(record, graphContext)\n          \n          // Extract reasoning from AI analysis for this specific record\n          const aiReasoning = extractReasoningForRecord(aiAnalysis, record.title || record.name)\n          \n          contextualRecords.push({\n            id: record.id || &#96;record-${Date.now()}-${Math.random()}&#96;,\n            type: inferEntityType(record),\n            title: record.title || record.name || record.subject || 'Untitled Record',\n            snippet: aiReasoning || generateRelationshipExplanation(record, graphContext, relationshipType),\n            relationshipScore: relationshipScore,\n            relationshipType: relationshipType,\n            confidence: Math.min(95, Math.max(60, Math.round(relationshipScore * 100)))\n          })\n        }\n      }\n      \n      // If no database results but we have AI analysis, create suggestions from analysis\n      if (contextualRecords.length === 0 \u0026\u0026 aiAnalysis) {\n        const analysisConnections = parseAIAnalysisForConnections(aiAnalysis, graphContext)\n        contextualRecords.push(...analysisConnections)\n      }\n      \n      // Sort by relationship score and confidence\n      contextualRecords.sort((a, b) =\u003e {\n        const scoreA = a.relationshipScore * 0.7 + (a.confidence / 100) * 0.3\n        const scoreB = b.relationshipScore * 0.7 + (b.confidence / 100) * 0.3\n        return scoreB - scoreA\n      })\n      \n      setSuggestions(contextualRecords.slice(0, 6))\n      \n    }",

        "contents": "export function ConnectedRecordsPanel() {\n  ...\n  const fetchContextualConnections = async\n ...\n catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error fetching contextual connections:', error)\n      setSuggestions([{\n        id: 'error',\n        type: 'documents',\n        title: 'Connection Analysis Error',\n        snippet: 'Unable to connect to disclosure analysis system. Please try again.',\n        relationshipScore: 0,\n        relationshipType: 'topic',\n        confidence: 0\n      }])\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false)\n    }\n  }\n  \n  // Helper functions for contextual intelligence integration\n  const calculateRelationshipScore = (record: any, context: any): number =\u003e {\n    let score = 0\n    \n    // Personnel connections (highest weight)\n    if (context.keyPersonnel?.length \u003e 0) {\n      const recordPersonnel = extractPersonnelFromRecord(record)\n      if (recordPersonnel.some(person =\u003e context.keyPersonnel.includes(person))) {\n        score += 0.4\n      }\n    }\n    \n    // Organizational connections  \n    if (context.organizations?.length \u003e 0) {\n      const recordOrgs = extractOrganizationsFromRecord(record)\n      if (recordOrgs.some(org =\u003e context.organizations.includes(org))) {\n        score += 0.3\n      }\n    }\n    \n    // Temporal relevance\n    if (record.date \u0026\u0026 context.timelineBounds?.earliest \u0026\u0026 context.timelineBounds?.latest) {\n      const recordDate = new Date(record.date)\n      const earliest = new Date(context.timelineBounds.earliest)\n      const latest = new Date(context.timelineBounds.latest)\n      \n      if (recordDate \u003e= earliest \u0026\u0026 recordDate \u003c= latest) {\n        score += 0.2\n      }\n    }\n    \n    // Topic relevance\n    if (context.relatedTopics?.length \u003e 0) {\n      const recordTopics = extractTopicsFromRecord(record)\n      if (recordTopics.some(topic =\u003e context.relatedTopics.includes(topic))) {\n        score += 0.1\n      }\n    }\n    \n    return Math.min(1.0, score)\n  }",

        "originalContents": " catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error fetching contextual connections:', error)\n      setSuggestions([{\n        id: 'error',\n        type: 'documents',\n        title: 'Connection Analysis Error',\n        snippet: 'Unable to connect to disclosure analysis system. Please try again.',\n        relationshipScore: 0,\n        relationshipType: 'topic',\n        confidence: 0\n      }])\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false)\n    }\n  }\n  \n  // Helper functions for contextual intelligence integration\n  const calculateRelationshipScore = (record: any, context: any): number =\u003e {\n    let score = 0\n    \n    // Personnel connections (highest weight)\n    if (context.keyPersonnel?.length \u003e 0) {\n      const recordPersonnel = extractPersonnelFromRecord(record)\n      if (recordPersonnel.some(person =\u003e context.keyPersonnel.includes(person))) {\n        score += 0.4\n      }\n    }\n    \n    // Organizational connections  \n    if (context.organizations?.length \u003e 0) {\n      const recordOrgs = extractOrganizationsFromRecord(record)\n      if (recordOrgs.some(org =\u003e context.organizations.includes(org))) {\n        score += 0.3\n      }\n    }\n    \n    // Temporal relevance\n    if (record.date \u0026\u0026 context.timelineBounds?.earliest \u0026\u0026 context.timelineBounds?.latest) {\n      const recordDate = new Date(record.date)\n      const earliest = new Date(context.timelineBounds.earliest)\n      const latest = new Date(context.timelineBounds.latest)\n      \n      if (recordDate \u003e= earliest \u0026\u0026 recordDate \u003c= latest) {\n        score += 0.2\n      }\n    }\n    \n    // Topic relevance\n    if (context.relatedTopics?.length \u003e 0) {\n      const recordTopics = extractTopicsFromRecord(record)\n      if (recordTopics.some(topic =\u003e context.relatedTopics.includes(topic))) {\n        score += 0.1\n      }\n    }\n    \n    return Math.min(1.0, score)\n  }",

        "contents": "export function ConnectedRecordsPanel() {\n\n  \n  ...\n\n  \n  const determineRelationshipType = (record: any, context: any): ConnectedRecord['relationshipType'] =\u003e {\n    // Check for personnel connections first\n    if (context.keyPersonnel?.length \u003e 0) {\n      const recordPersonnel = extractPersonnelFromRecord(record)\n      if (recordPersonnel.some(person =\u003e context.keyPersonnel.includes(person))) {\n        return 'personnel'\n      }\n    }\n    \n    // Check for organizational connections\n    if (context.organizations?.length \u003e 0) {\n      const recordOrgs = extractOrganizationsFromRecord(record)\n      if (recordOrgs.some(org =\u003e context.organizations.includes(org))) {\n        return 'organizational'\n      }\n    }\n    \n    // Check for temporal connections\n    if (record.date \u0026\u0026 context.timelineBounds?.earliest) {\n      return 'temporal'\n    }\n    \n    // Check for location connections\n    if (record.latitude || record.longitude) {\n      return 'location'\n    }\n    \n    return 'topic'\n  }\n  \n  // Extract AI reasoning for specific records from the comprehensive analysis\n  const extractReasoningForRecord = (aiAnalysis: string, recordTitle: string): string | null =\u003e {\n    if (!aiAnalysis || !recordTitle) return null\n    \n    // Look for patterns where the AI explains why a specific record was selected\n    const lines = aiAnalysis.split('\\n')\n    const recordTitleLower = recordTitle.toLowerCase()\n    \n    for (let i = 0; i \u003c lines.length; i++) {\n      const line = lines[i].toLowerCase()\n      if (line.includes(recordTitleLower) \u0026\u0026 (line.includes('selected') || line.includes('relevant') || line.includes('connected'))) {\n        // Found reasoning for this record, extract the full explanation\n        let reasoning = lines[i].trim()\n        \n        // Look ahead for continuation\n        let j = i + 1\n        while (j \u003c lines.length \u0026\u0026 lines[j].trim() \u0026\u0026 !lines[j].toLowerCase().includes('record')) {\n          reasoning += ' ' + lines[j].trim()\n          j++\n        }\n        \n        return reasoning.length \u003e 50 ? reasoning : null\n      }\n    }\n    \n    return null\n  }",

        "originalContents": "\n  \n  const determineRelationshipType = (record: any, context: any): ConnectedRecord['relationshipType'] =\u003e {\n    // Check for personnel connections first\n    if (context.keyPersonnel?.length \u003e 0) {\n      const recordPersonnel = extractPersonnelFromRecord(record)\n      if (recordPersonnel.some(person =\u003e context.keyPersonnel.includes(person))) {\n        return 'personnel'\n      }\n    }\n    \n    // Check for organizational connections\n    if (context.organizations?.length \u003e 0) {\n      const recordOrgs = extractOrganizationsFromRecord(record)\n      if (recordOrgs.some(org =\u003e context.organizations.includes(org))) {\n        return 'organizational'\n      }\n    }\n    \n    // Check for temporal connections\n    if (record.date \u0026\u0026 context.timelineBounds?.earliest) {\n      return 'temporal'\n    }\n    \n    // Check for location connections\n    if (record.latitude || record.longitude) {\n      return 'location'\n    }\n    \n    return 'topic'\n  }\n  \n  // Extract AI reasoning for specific records from the comprehensive analysis\n  const extractReasoningForRecord = (aiAnalysis: string, recordTitle: string): string | null =\u003e {\n    if (!aiAnalysis || !recordTitle) return null\n    \n    // Look for patterns where the AI explains why a specific record was selected\n    const lines = aiAnalysis.split('\\n')\n    const recordTitleLower = recordTitle.toLowerCase()\n    \n    for (let i = 0; i \u003c lines.length; i++) {\n      const line = lines[i].toLowerCase()\n      if (line.includes(recordTitleLower) \u0026\u0026 (line.includes('selected') || line.includes('relevant') || line.includes('connected'))) {\n        // Found reasoning for this record, extract the full explanation\n        let reasoning = lines[i].trim()\n        \n        // Look ahead for continuation\n        let j = i + 1\n        while (j \u003c lines.length \u0026\u0026 lines[j].trim() \u0026\u0026 !lines[j].toLowerCase().includes('record')) {\n          reasoning += ' ' + lines[j].trim()\n          j++\n        }\n        \n        return reasoning.length \u003e 50 ? reasoning : null\n      }\n    }\n    \n    return null\n  }",

        "contents": "\n\nexport const AskAIStreaming: React.FC\u003cAskAIStreamingProps\u003e = ({\n  question,\n  table,\n  rules = [],\n  nodeId,\n  onComplete,\n  onError,\n}) =\u003e {\n  console.log('🚀 ~ table:', table)\n\n  console.log('🚀 ~ question:', question)\n\n  const endpoint = '/api/sse/xata/ask'\n  const {streaming, isConnected, error, records, isComplete, postQuery} = useSSE(endpoint)\n\n  console.log('🚀 ~ isConnected:', isConnected)\n\n  console.log('🚀 ~ streaming:', streaming)\n\n  const [status, setStatus] = useState\u003cstring\u003e('idle')\n\n  // For debugging - log state changes\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    console.log('AskAIStreaming state update:', {\n      status,\n      isConnected,\n      streamingLength: streaming?.length || 0,\n      recordCount: records?.length || 0,\n      isComplete\n    });\n  }, [status, isConnected, streaming, records, isComplete]);\n\n  // Start the query when the component mounts\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (question \u0026\u0026 table) {\n      console.log(&#96;Starting query for: ${table} - ${question.substring(0, 50)}&#96;);\n      setStatus('loading')\n      postQuery(question, table, rules).then((success) =\u003e {\n        console.log(&#96;Query initialization ${success ? 'successful' : 'failed'}&#96;);\n        if (success) {\n          setStatus('streaming');\n        } else {\n          setStatus('error');\n        }\n      })\n    }\n  }, [question, table, rules, postQuery])\n\n  // Only notify parent when complete or error\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (isComplete \u0026\u0026 onComplete \u0026\u0026 streaming) {\n      console.log('Stream complete! Notifying parent with:', {\n        answerLength: streaming?.length || 0,\n        recordCount: records?.length || 0\n      });\n      \n      onComplete({\n        answer: streaming,\n        entities: records || [],\n      });\n      \n      setStatus('complete');\n    }\n  }, [isComplete, streaming, records, onComplete])\n\n  // Handle errors\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (error \u0026\u0026 onError) {\n      onError(error)\n    }\n  }, [error, onError])",
```

```json
        "contents": "export async function POST( req: Request ) {\n  ...\n  return\n    ...\n    async ( { forwardStream, sendDataMessage } ) =\u003e {\n      ...\n      while (\n        runResult?.status === \"requires_action\" \u0026\u0026\n        runResult.required_action?.type === \"submit_tool_outputs\"\n      ) {\n\n\n          ...\n\n\n          if ( toolCall.function.name === \"searchDatabase\" ) {\n            // Use entities from file search results\n            const previousResult = toolResults.fileSearchResult\n\n            // Get search terms either from parameters or extract from previous result\n            const searchTerms =\n              parameters.search_terms ||\n              previousResult?.entities?.map( ( e ) =\u003e e.name ) ||\n              []\n\n            const searchResult = await searchDatabase( {\n              table: parameters.table,\n              searchTerms,\n              searchFields: parameters.search_fields,\n            } )\n\n            sendDataMessage( {\n              role: \"data\",\n              data: {\n                tool: \"searchDatabase\",\n                status: \"complete\",\n                result: searchResult,\n              },\n            } )\n\n            tool_outputs.push( {\n              tool_call_id: toolCall.id,\n              output: JSON.stringify( searchResult ),\n            } )\n          }\n        }\n\n        // Submit all tool outputs and continue the run\n        runResult = await forwardStream(\n          openai.beta.threads.runs.submitToolOutputsStream(\n            threadId,\n            runResult.id,\n            { tool_outputs },\n          ),\n        )\n      }\n\n      return runResult\n    },\n  )\n}",

        "contents": "\n\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url)\n    \n    const keyword = searchParams.get('keyword')\n    const table = searchParams.get('table')\n\n    if (!keyword) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: 'Keyword parameter is required' },\n        { status: 400 }\n      )\n    }\n\n    if (!table) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: 'Table parameter is required' },\n        { status: 400 }\n      )\n    }\n\n    console.log('🚀 ~ GET ~ keyword:', keyword)\n    console.log('🚀 ~ GET ~ table:', table)\n\n    // Use the searchXata function to get results\n    const searchResponse = await searchXata({\n      query: keyword,\n      table: table\n    })\n\n    if (!searchResponse.success) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: searchResponse.error || 'Search failed' },\n        { status: 500 }\n      )\n    }\n\n    const searchResults = searchResponse.searchResults || []\n    console.log('🚀 ~ GET ~ searchResults:', searchResults)\n\n    // Format the response to match what the mindmap expects\n    const response: SearchResult = {\n      suggestedSearchResult: {\n        record: searchResults.length \u003e 0 ? searchResults[0] : null\n      },\n      relatedResults: searchResults.slice(1, 6), // Return up to 5 related results\n      totalCount: searchResults.length\n    }\n\n    console.log('🚀 ~ GET ~ response:', response)\n\n    return NextResponse.json(response)\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error in table search API:', error)\n    return NextResponse.json(\n      { \n        error: 'Failed to search table',\n        details: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'\n      },\n      { status: 500 }\n    )\n  }\n}",
```

## 📋 **Comprehensive Smart Connections Enhancement Plan**

Based on my research and analysis of the existing codebase, here's the complete plan to transform the smart connections feature from manual to automated background processing:

### 🎯 **Current State Analysis**

**Existing Architecture Strengths:**
- Robust Prometheus AI integration with OpenAI Assistant API
- Sophisticated Xata vector search with built-in reasoning
- Well-structured mindmap context using Zustand + React Context
- Existing streaming API patterns for real-time updates
- Proven smart connections logic in `connected-records-panel.tsx`

**Key Limitations to Address:**
- Manual trigger system (`fetchContextualConnections()` only on user click)
- No background processing infrastructure
- Lack of connection caching mechanisms
- UI blocking during connection discovery
- No progressive relationship visualization

### 🏗️ **Architecture Enhancement Strategy**

**1. Background Processing Layer (T-97)**
```typescript
// Enhanced mindmap context with background processor
interface BackgroundProcessor {
  isActive: boolean
  processingQueue: Set<string> // Node IDs to process
  connectionCache: Map<string, {
    connections: ConnectedRecord[]
    timestamp: number
    expiry: number
  }>
  lastGraphSnapshot: string // Hash of current graph state
}
```

**2. Intelligent Connection Discovery (T-97)**
- **Debounced Processing**: Wait 2-3 seconds after graph changes
- **Progressive Depth**: Start with immediate connections, expand gradually
- **Context-Aware Batching**: Group similar entities for efficient API calls
- **Cache-First Strategy**: Check cache before making API requests

**3. Subtle Visual Indicators (T-98)**
- **Animated SVG Connection Lines**: Subtle, transparent pathways
- **Progressive Disclosure**: Fade in connections based on relevance
- **Interactive Depth Control**: User adjusts connection visibility
- **Accessibility Compliance**: Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`

**4. Enhanced State Management (T-97)**
```typescript
// Extended mindmap context capabilities
const backgroundProcessor = {
  // Auto-discovery when nodes change
  processGraphChanges: useDeferredValue(nodeChangeSignal),
  
  // Intelligent caching with invalidation
  cacheConnections: useCallback(async (nodeContext) => {
    // Implementation using React 19 concurrent features
  }),
  
  // Background API integration
  discoverConnections: useCallback(async (nodes) => {
    // Leverage existing Prometheus + Xata integration
  })
}
```

### 🔄 **Implementation Sequence**

**Phase 1: Foundation (T-94, T-95, T-96) - Research Complete ✅**
- ✅ Architecture analysis completed
- ✅ Background processing design finalized
- ✅ UI/UX research documented

**Phase 2: Core Backend (T-97) - Next Priority**
- Implement background processor hook
- Enhance mindmap context with background state
- Integrate with existing Prometheus + Xata APIs
- Add intelligent caching with LRU eviction

**Phase 3: Visual Enhancement (T-98) - Parallel with Phase 2**
- Create animated SVG connection indicators
- Implement subtle transparency and hover effects
- Add smooth transitions for connection appearance
- Ensure accessibility compliance

**Phase 4: User Controls (T-99) - After Core Backend**
- Add depth/visibility control slider
- Implement connection type filtering
- Add user preference persistence
- Create settings panel integration

**Phase 5: Optimization (T-100) - Final Phase**
- Performance testing with large mindmaps
- Memory optimization and leak prevention
- Connection virtualization for scalability
- Comprehensive testing suite

### 💡 **Key Integration Points**

**1. Leverage Existing Prometheus Integration**
```typescript

  const response = await fetch('/api/disclosure/mindmap', {
    method: 'POST',
    body: JSON.stringify({
      threadId: backgroundThreadId, // Dedicated background thread
      message: generateIntelligentQuery(nodeContext)
    })
```

**2. Enhance Xata Vector Search Usage**

```typescript
  visualWeight: record.xataReasoning?.score || 0,
```

### 🔧 **Technical Implementation Details**

**Background Processing Strategy:**
- **React 19 Concurrent Features**: `useDeferredValue` for non-blocking updates
- **Intelligent Debouncing**: 2-3 second delay after graph changes
- **Memory-Efficient Caching**: LRU cache with 50MB limit
- **API Rate Limiting**: Maximum 1 request per 5 seconds

**Performance Optimization:**
- **Connection Virtualization**: Only process visible graph area
- **Progressive Loading**: Start with high-confidence connections
- **Background Refresh**: Update cache during idle periods
- **Graceful Degradation**: Fallback to manual mode if background fails
